text_block_list.text:
While walking through the school building, 
I heard pitter-pattering footsteps coming 
from behind me.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, Trainer! I wanted to touch base 
regarding Jordan's recent exam—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Wha~at? Calling me over out of nowhere~
choice_data_list: ...I hear you got a failing grade.
...I hear you got a failing grade.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Teehee~☆
choice_data_list:
Don't 'tee-hee' me. We're studying for the 
makeup exam.

Don't 'tee-hee' me. We're studying for the 
makeup exam, okay?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Geh?! For real—?! With yoooou~?!

Make-up exams usually continue until you 
pass, so the more you fail, the more 
practice time you end up losing.

Besides, passing the test will give her an 
experience of success. That should 
positively impact her future growth as 
well.
choice_data_list: Don't you want to "win" on your test?
Don't you want to "win" against the test?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
You thought turning it into that kind of 
competition would get me motivated, huh?

And right now, Tosen Jordan was facing the 
questions on the desk before her.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I have no clue what's going on... What am 
I even supposed to write...?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I don't know the formulas~... Like, 
seriously, isn't there way too much to 
memorize~...?

It seems her failing grade this time was 
due to having trouble memorizing the 
material.
choice_data_list:
Then let's try learning it while moving 
our bodies!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Huh. What is this?
choice_data_list:
Try saying that out loud while doing a 
light run!

text_block_list.text:
In the notepad I handed to Tosen Jordan, I 
had written down various formulas for the 
subjects she'd likely be tested on in her 
retakes.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
No way! That's so embarrassing!! While 
running?! No way, absolutely not!!

Still, from a neuroscience perspective, 
memorization subjects are easier to retain 
during light exercise. For an Umamusume, 
running should be just right.
choice_data_list: Or will you lose to the test?
Or are you gonna fail the test?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
The way you said that is so, so 
unfair~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Tangent! Equals! Sine over cosine!!
choice_data_list: What's the equation of motion!?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah~~~!? M-A equals F~~~!?
choice_data_list: That's the spirit!!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Jordan-san, isn't that amazing?! You 
passed all your makeup exams!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Right~? Totally. Isn't it crazy? I'm 
totally unmatched, right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Geez, it's all because Trainer made me do 
that stuff~.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my, the Trainer has study tips? Do 
they have their own unique way of teaching 
Jordan? Perhaps I should ask them too.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Better not, really don't. Seeing Teach 
trying to act like that guy would be super 
cringe.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...To be honest, she only gets away with 
that stuff because it's her.

I peek at the problem sheet Tosen Jordan 
is working on. It appears to be a math 
proof.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...Since n is an odd number, n is 2k plus 
1, so-......"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Ah~... Feels like something's off. What 
did Teach say again~...?

Tosen Jordan took her eraser and 
completely rubbed out the equation she had 
been halfway through solving.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Phew~...
choice_data_list: Why did you erase all of it?
Why did you erase everything?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Because there's no way that's not wrong. 
It's totally an X, right? I'm gonna get a 
ton of red tick marks, aren't I?
choice_data_list:
Even if it's not the right answer, let's 
write it down.

text_block_list.text:
If it's a proof problem, even if the final 
answer is incorrect, you still get partial 
credit as long as the steps along the way 
are right.
choice_data_list:
Besides, I want to show your teacher the 
proof of all your hard work.

Besides, I want to show your teacher the 
proof of all your hard work.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... Seriously, you really act like a 
true Trainer.
choice_data_list: What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: It means just that~.

Afterward, Tosen Jordan silently and 
diligently kept working through the 
practice problems.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I just barely failed. Looks like 
another retake for me~.
choice_data_list: I see~

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
But I'm totally gonna pass next time. 
Teach said that since I worked hard, I'll 
definitely make it next time anyway.

I felt like she was even more fired up 
than usual for training that day.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I mean, seriously. Just thinking out loud 
here, but do we actually need to study?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
You can't solve this problem either, can 
you, Trainer? Be honest, you totally 
forgot the formulas, didn't you?

Feeling the pressure from Tosen Jordan's 
suspicious gaze, I look over her test 
paper.

The genre is mathematics. Seems to be a 
probability problem. Looking at what's 
written here, you use combinations, or 'C' 
to...
choice_data_list: ...What formula was that again...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: See~! You totally forgot, didn't you!

Now that I'm faced with the questions, my 
mind went totally blank. I used to 
remember quite a bit back in my student 
days, but...
choice_data_list: Still, I remember studying really hard.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
choice_data_list:
Maybe that's why you're able to keep up 
with your studies even now.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Even now? ...Ah.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...So Trainers have their own studying to 
do too, huh?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
choice_data_list:
Still, maybe I should hit the books again 
too!
Still, maybe I should study up again too!

text_block_list.text:
I take out a notepad and pen, and copy 
down the problem Tosen Jordan was solving.
choice_data_list: Let's see who can solve it first!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh!? A match!? Wait, hold on a sec!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Why'd you start solving it already?! 
That's so unfair! I object to false 
starts!!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"So... you'll be participating alongside 
her in this makeup exam, Trainer?"
choice_data_list: Because that gets Jordan more motivated!!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text: Are you an idiot?!

As for the result... let's just say Tosen 
Jordan and I had a good match.
